name: mikuinvidious
description: A free as in freedom frontend for Bilibili.

scripts.build:i18n: uv run pybabel extract -F babel.cfg -o locales/messages.pot python templates static/themes/modern/js && uv run python tools/pomerge.py && uv run python tools/po2json.py
scripts.check:i18n: uv run python tools/pomerge.py --check && uv run python tools/po2json.py --check
scripts.sync:static: npm update --ignore-scripts hls.js mpegts.js media-chrome hls-video-element opencc-js dashjs danmaku && node tools/sync-static.js
scripts.test: PYTHONPATH=python uv run python -m unittest discover tests
scripts.check:compile: uv run python -m compileall -f python tests tools
scripts.lint: npm run lint:python && npm run lint:frontend
scripts.format: npm run format:python && npm run format:frontend
